description: Request pod deletion. Billing stops when accepted; deletion may finish asynchronously (get_pod shows DELETING). Data on the pod is lost. Before calling, read the pod (get_pod or list_pods) and get_balance, then tell the user in your reply, not only in the approval: the pod name and id, its GPU, its price per hour and their current balance, and that data on the pod is lost. Call only after they agree, also when they asked you not to ask; one call per pod.

pod_id.description: Pod id, as list_pods shows it

pod_name.description: The pod's name as get_pod shows it, the one you told the user

name: remove_pod
title: Remove a Lium pod
